# Copilot instructions (<PROJECT_NAME>)

Before doing anything in this repository, read `AGENTS.md` at the repo root — it is the canonical rule router for every AI agent — then `.agents/rules/00-core.md` (always applies). Load the purpose-specific rules and skills listed in `AGENTS.md` §2 (coding / debugging / planning). Repo rules win over any tool-level instructions when they conflict. When unsure, ask the Product Owner instead of guessing.
